answer: To resist Sybil attacks, agents anchor to a consensus beacon and form an audited trust graph. Inter-agent interactions branch like a vine across the network nebula. Autonomous verifiers perform topological cut verifications to detect bottleneck boundaries between identity clusters; if a cut exposes an isolated, dense cluster with coordinated cross-audits, stake slashing occurs. This structure enforces a superlinear attacker cost relative to forged identities.
